about_the_game:
Begin your journey in a world where a new civilization takes root, shaped by survival, belief, and the gods who watch from above. In this demo, you’ll get a glimpse of what it means to lead a civilization through divine trials, mortal needs, and unpredictable events. Gather food, hunt wild animals, process materials, and build production chains to meet the demands of your people. Whether alone or with a friend in online co-op, your task is to grow a thriving settlement while surviving the whims of the gods.

This free demo introduces core gameplay mechanics from the full version of The Whims of the Gods.

>>> THE DEMO VERSION INCLUDES <<<

Construct and Expand

Lay the foundations of your ancient city with a diverse set of early-game buildings. Set up production chains, manage food sources, gather resources, and meet the evolving needs of your people.

Shape Your Civilization

Make meaningful decisions that influence your technological progression. Each choice unlocks new structures and capabilities, letting you evolve your city in different directions.

Play Solo or in Co-Op
Whether you prefer to command alone or share the burden with a friend, the demo supports both single-player and two-player cooperative gameplay.

Invoke the Gods

Experience the first layers of the divine interaction system. Appeal to the gods for blessings or provoke their wrath.

Explore and Unlock

Explore a handcrafted map veiled in fog, with multiple regions waiting to be uncovered. As you progress, perform rituals to unlock new areas and expand your territory. This demo features one such map - just a glimpse of the wider world to come in the full game.

Survive the Whims

Manage hunger, housing, and morale to keep your workers productive. These core systems will challenge your ability to plan ahead and respond to changing circumstances.

Are you ready to prove your worth to the gods, or will your civilization crumble under their whims?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5 6300 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD equivalent, 6 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7 8700k or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD equivalent, 6 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: The Whims of the Gods is a city-building game where you can play solo or join forces in co-op to shape an ancient civilization, manage people and resources, face divine challenges, and survive under the ever-watchful gaze of the gods.
